article.title: 騰訊發布Buddy One，以WorkBuddy串連辦公工具與儲存
article.title_en: Tencent announces Buddy One to connect WorkBuddy with workplace tools and storage
article.summary: 據新浪科技10月29日現場報道，騰訊在全球數字生態大會發布Buddy One，以WorkBuddy為工作台整合騰訊文檔、ima及騰訊網盤等工具。
article.summary_en: Sina Technology reported from Tencent’s October 29 ecosystem conference that Buddy One uses WorkBuddy as a workspace connecting Tencent Docs, ima and Tencent Drive.

article.detail:
據新浪科技10月29日現場報道，騰訊在全球數字生態大會發布Buddy One，以WorkBuddy為工作台整合騰訊文檔、ima及騰訊網盤等工具。

湯道生表示，不同工具可共用帳號及積分池，並按任務需要調用工具生成多模態內容。

騰訊網盤被定位為統一儲存空間，保存代理工作上下文及產出，供團隊協作與驗收。

對已有騰訊辦公工具的中國市場團隊，重點是跨工具交接及內容資產管理，而非單一生成指令。

先確認帳戶地區、企業權限與可接入產品，選一個簡報任務檢查版本、資料隔離及最終驗收。

內容按大會發言歸因；報道未提供完整香港開放名單、價格或所有企業帳戶條款，本刊未測試。
article.detail_en:
Sina Technology reported from Tencent’s October 29 ecosystem conference that Buddy One uses WorkBuddy as a workspace connecting Tencent Docs, ima and Tencent Drive.

Dowson Tong described unified accounts and a credit pool, with tools invoked according to task needs for multimodal creation.

Tencent Drive is positioned as shared storage for agent context and output, supporting team collaboration and review.

For China-market teams using Tencent tools, the practical question is cross-tool handoffs and management of content assets.

Confirm account regions, enterprise permissions and supported products, then inspect versions, data boundaries and approval on one presentation task.

The report attributes capabilities to conference remarks; full Hong Kong availability, pricing and enterprise terms are not established here.
